mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a chilly 57 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Third Quarter moon phase. Tonight, expect the temperature to drop to a low of 49 degrees with rain likely to fall overnight.

In city news, the Public Works Department reminds residents that refuse and recycling are handled by Pellitteri Waste Systems, and you can find your collection calendar on the city website. Also, please note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for trivia nights happening throughout next week at Hop Haus, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they discovered a man passed out in his vehicle, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.

If you are craving something sweet, stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Mint Explosion. They are open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to grab a treat before they close for the night.
